items.title: Pay invoice for daughter's occupational therapy
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag binnen 21 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum.
items.computation: This is a private civil-law invoice, so the period is counted under §§ 187, 188 BGB. The triggering event is the Rechnungsdatum itself (18.11.2026); per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event is not counted, so the 21-day period begins on 19.11.2026 (day 1). Day 21 falls on 09.12.2026 (19.11→30.11 = 12 days, then 01.12→09.12 = 9 more days, 12+9=21). 09.12.2026 is a Wednesday, not a Saturday/Sunday/holiday in NRW, so no § 193 BGB extension applies. Final due date: 09.12.2026.
